reviews.comment: This class was way harder than it should be. She expects you to understand the lecture content as if you were at her level of knowledge. "If you don't understand it, then I can't help you". She is just a frustrating professor. Grades are not a reflection of your effort in this class. I ended up getting an A after an immense amount of burn out.

I really enjoyed this class. If you pay attention and apply what is taught, the material becomes much easier to understand. The tests were not as bad as I expected as long as you stayed engaged and kept up with the work. Overall, an amazing professor who truly wants students to succeed.

Dr. Wang is a great professor despite the bad reviews, however if you do not intend to put a lot of extra time to ensure you master al topics you will fail. Many people end up dropping out the class due to her hard grading policy on lecture and lab. You must put a lot of outside effort and attend her office hours to pass the class with a B or an A.

Tell me why this class is harder than AP 1.Extra hard exams, drop this class asap (even if you think that you will be fine, no you wont). She would literally take off points from the post labs and exams after she already posted grades for no reason. My friends all dropped the course and I wish I did too.

If you aren't religious, pick a religion and start praying. She would randomly take off points on exams after she already posted grades and other assignments with no explanation which brought my grade down a lot. 1/3 of the class dropped her class and majority of the students that stayed had high C's.
Explains concepts well and cares about her students. No curve, so the grade you get is final. Not too hard as long as you actually do and learn the material on the hw and in class.

I took CHEM 119 with Dr. Wang, and had a positive experience over all. This is a challenging class, but doable if you keep up with the lecture notes and review heavily. She does give out weekly quizzes, and an exam every 2-3 weeks. If you use the notes she provides, and practice exams, you will be more then prepared for her exams and quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: My experience in chem 120 w/ her was alright. In most of her weekly quizzes, there will be something we didn't quite go over or a method we've yet to learn. Same goes for a couple questions on the exams. Smartsheets are difficult most of the time because the instructions can be vague sometimes, same w/ DRAs. She doesn't explain either of them well.

Professor Wang is a great professor! I took CHEM 119 with her and it was a tough class, but she does help you. There is quite a bit of homework but its easy. Pre-labs and post-labs were actually not that hard. But be sure to always STUDY everything before an exam. She explains everything and gives extra credit. I got a tutor for extra help.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Chemistry in itself is a difficult class. The class involved a lot of hw and plenty of quizzes, but in the end they help with understanding the content. While sometimes the lectures were a little difficult to comprehend she did well in trying to break down the material. You have to put in time to study!! Overall thought she was a great teacher!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: There is alot of homework, but you're going to get that with every Chem class. She will make you think about how you should answer your questions rather than walk you through them. She is a hard grader but fair. Communicate with her throughout the semester because she is understanding. This class is difficult but communication will help you out.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.
